verdict.rationale: Docs confirm point-in-time snapshots of directories that can be restored from R2 (cloudflare-sandbox-docs-8), which covers snapshot/restore, but there's no evidence of forking new sandbox instances from a snapshot, and community feedback notes ambiguity around how persistence actually behaves when a container goes idle (cloudflare-sandbox-comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit fork/clone-from-snapshot capability, full-sandbox (not just directory) snapshotting, and independent confirmation that restored snapshots behave as expected.
